entries.title: Jeremiah 50:1
segments: ¶The word that the LORD spake against Babylon [and] against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet. {by...: Heb. by the hand of Jeremiah}

words.text: . {by...: Heb. by the hand of Jeremiah}

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:2
segments: Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, [and] conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces. {set up: Heb. lift up}

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:3
segments: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:4
segments: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek the LORD their God.

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:5
segments: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward, [saying], Come, and let us join ourselves to the LORD in a perpetual covenant [that] shall not be forgotten.

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:6
segments: My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away [on] the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace. {restingplace: Heb. place to lie down in}

words.text: have caused them to go astray
. {restingplace: Heb. place to lie down in}

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:7
segments: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the LORD, the habitation of justice, even the LORD, the hope of their fathers.

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:8
segments: Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.

words.text: , and be as the he goats

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:9
segments: ¶For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows [shall be] as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain. {expert...: or, destroyer}

words.text: : and they shall set themselves in array
against her; from thence she shall be taken

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:10
segments: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, saith the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:11
segments: Because ye were glad, because ye rejoiced, O ye destroyers of mine heritage, because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls; {fat: Heb. big, or, corpulent} {bellow...: or, neigh as steeds}

words.text: ; {fat: Heb. big, or, corpulent} {bellow...: or, neigh as steeds}

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:12
segments: Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations [shall be] a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:13
segments: Because of the wrath of the LORD it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.

words.text: , but it shall be wholly desolate

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:14
segments: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:15
segments: Shout against her round about: she hath given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it [is] the vengeance of the LORD: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.

words.text: upon her; as she hath done

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:16
segments: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land. {sickle; or, scythe}

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:17
segments: Israel [is] a scattered sheep; the lions have driven [him] away: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:18
segments: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:19
segments: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:20
segments: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and [there shall be] none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.

words.text: , and [there shall be] none; and the sins
, and they shall not be found

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:21
segments: ¶Go up against the land of Merathaim, [even] against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, saith the LORD, and do according to all that I have commanded thee. {of Merathaim: or, of the rebels} {Pekod: or, Visitation}

words.text: , [even] against it, and against the inhabitants
according to all that I have commanded
thee. {of Merathaim: or, of the rebels} {Pekod: or, Visitation}

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:22
segments: A sound of battle [is] in the land, and of great destruction.

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:23
segments: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:24
segments: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babylon, and thou wast not aware: thou art found, and also caught, because thou hast striven against the LORD.

words.text: for thee, and thou art also taken

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:25
segments: The LORD hath opened his armoury, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this [is] the work of the Lord GOD of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:26
segments: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left. {from...: Heb. from the end} {cast...: or, tread her}

words.text: against her from the utmost border
: let nothing of her be left
. {from...: Heb. from the end} {cast...: or, tread her}

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:27
segments: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:28
segments: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance of his temple.

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:29
segments: Call together the archers against Babylon: all ye that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her: for she hath been proud against the LORD, against the Holy One of Israel.

words.text: ; according to all that she hath done
unto her: for she hath been proud

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:30
segments: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:31
segments: Behold, I [am] against thee, [O thou] most proud, saith the Lord GOD of hosts: for thy day is come, the time [that] I will visit thee. {most...: Heb. pride}

words.text: Behold, I [am] against thee, [O thou] most proud

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:32
segments: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him. {the...: Heb. pride}

words.text: , and none shall raise him up

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:33
segments: ¶Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah [were] oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.

words.text: : and all that took them captives

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:34
segments: Their Redeemer [is] strong; the LORD of hosts [is] his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:35
segments: A sword [is] upon the Chaldeans, saith the LORD, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise [men].

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:36
segments: A sword [is] upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword [is] upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed. {liars: or, chief stays: Heb. bars}

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:37
segments: A sword [is] upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that [are] in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword [is] upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.

words.text: , and upon all the mingled people
of her; and they shall become as women

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:38
segments: A drought [is] upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it [is] the land of graven images, and they are mad upon [their] idols.

words.text: ; and they shall be dried up

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:39
segments: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell [there], and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.

words.text: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert
with the wild beasts of the islands
therein: and it shall be no more inhabited

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:40
segments: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour [cities] thereof, saith the LORD; [so] shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:41
segments: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:42
segments: They shall hold the bow and the lance: they [are] cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, [every one] put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:43
segments: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, [and] pangs as of a woman in travail.

words.text: as of a woman in travail

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:44
segments: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who [is] a chosen [man, that] I may appoint over her? for who [is] like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who [is] that shepherd that will stand before me? {appoint me...: or, convent me to plead?}

words.text: from her: and who [is] a chosen
over her? for who [is] like me? and who will appoint me the time
me? {appoint me...: or, convent me to plead?}

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:45
segments: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make [their] habitation desolate with them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 50:46
segments: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.
